The '''icelords''' are icy beings found inside the [[iceberg]], and are encountered during the [[Cold War]] [[Quests|quest]]. They were found when [[Pescaling Pax]] moved much of the [[penguin]] population to the iceberg to prepare for the invasion of [[Gielinor]]. Some icelords enjoy hurling large icicles at their enemies, while others prefer to use their four arms to pummel them into submission.

After completing Cold War, icelords can be accessed by entering [[a crack]] in the ice on the iceberg, then entering the icelords' cage. Three of the icelords use [[melee]], and the one wielding icicles uses [[ranged]], with all of them having low [[magic]] defence.

Icelords can be slain in place of [[ice warrior]]s for the purposes of completing a [[Slayer task]]. They have slightly more hitpoints than ice warriors as well as notably weaker offensive and defensive stats.

Killing an icelord will award the player with a bonus 40 [[Attack]] experience during the Cold War quest.
